name: Shion Fukushima
source:
A student from the art club. She adores her brother Kanata greatly until one day he starts being violent to her. She comes to the Fortune Telling club in hopes to get advice on how to deal with his brother and to fix their relationship.

[spoiler]She's actually the one responsible for his brother becoming physically disabled and having to give up his dream of becoming a professional baseball player[/spoiler]
